settings.name: logic_rules
settings.label: Logic Rules
settings.tooltip: How the randomizer makes sure every seed can be beaten. Glitchless: no glitch is ever needed; the tricks you turn on in Detailed Logic may be. Glitched (remake glitches): Glitchless plus every remake glitch with a route shown to work in this remake (jump slash cancels, actor jumps, the child Shadow Temple, the King Zora and Gerudo Card skips and more: Detailed Logic > Remake glitches lists them and where they apply). A seed may need any of them. OoT Randomizer's own glitched logic is for the N64 game, whose glitches don't work here, so it isn't offered. No Logic: items go anywhere and nothing is checked, so the seed may be impossible to beat.

disable.note: Glitched logic already includes every remake glitch with a route in logic.

settings.name: open_forest
settings.label: Forest
settings.tooltip: 'Open Forest': Mido no longer blocks the path to the Deku Tree, and the Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path out of the forest. 'Deku opens automatically': Same as Closed Deku, but when both Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield are found, Mido moves automatically, and Deku Tree opens his mouth for adult in Dungeon Entrance rando. 'Closed Deku': The Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path out of the forest, but Mido still blocks the path to the Deku Tree, requiring Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield to access the Deku Tree. 'Closed Forest': Beating Deku Tree is logically required to leave the forest area (Kokiri Forest/Lost Woods/Sacred Forest Meadow/Deku Tree), while the Kokiri Sword and a Deku Shield are required to access the Deku Tree. Items needed for this will be guaranteed inside the forest area. This setting is incompatible with starting as adult, and so Starting Age will be locked to Child. With any of "Shuffle Interior Entrances" set to "All", "Shuffle Overworld Entrances" on, "Randomize Warp Song Destinations" on, "Randomize Overworld Spawns" on, or "Shuffle Grottos" in Advanced Logic, Closed Forest will instead be treated as Closed Deku with starting age Child and WILL NOT guarantee that these items are available in the forest area.

settings.name: open_kakariko
settings.label: Kakariko Gate
settings.tooltip: This changes the behavior of the Kakariko Gate to Death Mountain Trail as child. The gate is always open as adult. "Open Gate": The gate is always open instead of needing Zelda's Letter. The Happy Mask Shop opens upon obtaining Zelda's Letter without needing to show it to the guard. "Zelda's Letter Opens Gate": The gate is closed at the start, but opens automatically along with the Happy Mask Shop upon obtaining Zelda's Letter. "Closed": The gate and the Happy Mask Shop both remain closed until showing Zelda's Letter to the guard in Kakariko.

settings.name: open_door_of_time
settings.label: Door of Time
settings.tooltip: 'Open': The Door of Time starts opened instead of needing to play the Song of Time. 'Song of Time': Only an Ocarina and Song of Time must be found to open the Door of Time. This is the vanilla behavior despite what the story suggests. 'Ocarina of Time + Song of Time': The Door of Time is opened by playing the Song of Time on the Ocarina of Time. '3 Spiritual Stones': The Door of Time automatically opens upon collecting all three Spiritual Stones. Song of Time is not required. '3 Stones + Song of Time': The Door of Time is opened by playing the Song of Time after collecting all three Spiritual Stones. '3 Stones + OoT + SoT': The Door of Time is opened by playing the Song of Time on the Ocarina of Time after collecting all three Spiritual Stones.
choices: Ocarina of Time + Song of Time

settings.name: zora_fountain
settings.label: Zora's Fountain
settings.tooltip: 'Default Behavior': King Zora obstructs the way to Zora's Fountain. Ruto's Letter must be shown as child in order to move him for both eras. 'Opens automatically with Letter': King Zora will move automatically for both ages when Ruto's Letter is found. 'Open For Adult': King Zora is always moved in the adult era. This means Ruto's Letter is only required to access Zora's Fountain as child. 'Always Open': King Zora starts as moved in both the child and adult eras. This also removes Ruto's Letter from the pool since it can't be used.

settings.name: remake_sleeping_waterfall
settings.label: Zora's River Waterfall
settings.tooltip: 'Open': the waterfall to Zora's Domain is parted from the start, so getting in needs no Zelda's Lullaby (Ship of Harkinian's Sleeping Waterfall).

settings.name: remake_jabu_mouth
settings.label: Jabu-Jabu's Mouth
settings.tooltip: Ship of Harkinian's / OoT3D Randomizer's open Jabu.

settings.name: gerudo_fortress
settings.label: Gerudo's Fortress
settings.tooltip: 'Rescue One Carpenter': Only the bottom left carpenter, in the cell with a single torch, must be rescued. This cell can be savewarped to from any room in the hideout. All but one of the Thieves' Hideout Keys are removed. 'Open Gerudo's Fortress': The carpenters are rescued from the start of the game, and if 'Shuffle Gerudo Card' is disabled, the player starts with the Gerudo Card in the inventory allowing access to Gerudo Training Ground.

settings.name: bridge
settings.label: Rainbow Bridge Requirement
settings.tooltip: 'Always Open': Rainbow Bridge is always present. 'Vanilla Requirements': Spirit/Shadow Medallions and Light Arrows. 'Spiritual Stones': A configurable amount of Spiritual Stones. 'Medallions': A configurable amount of Medallions. 'Dungeon Rewards': A configurable amount of Dungeon Rewards. 'Gold Skulltula Tokens': A configurable amount of Gold Skulltula Tokens. 'Hearts': A configurable amount of hearts. 'Random': A random Rainbow Bridge requirement excluding Gold Skulltula Tokens.

settings.name: bridge_medallions
settings.label: Medallions Required for Bridge
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Medallions required to spawn the rainbow bridge.

settings.name: bridge_stones
settings.label: Spiritual Stones Required for Bridge
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Spiritual Stones required to spawn the rainbow bridge.

settings.name: bridge_rewards
settings.label: Dungeon Rewards Required for Bridge
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Dungeon Rewards (Medallions and Spiritual Stones) required to spawn the rainbow bridge.

settings.name: bridge_tokens
settings.label: Skulltulas Required for Bridge
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Gold Skulltula Tokens required to spawn the rainbow bridge.

settings.name: bridge_hearts
settings.label: Hearts Required for Bridge
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of hearts required to spawn the rainbow bridge.

settings.name: trials_random
settings.label: Random Number of Ganon's Trials
settings.tooltip: Sets a random number of trials to enter Ganon's Tower.

settings.name: trials
settings.label: Ganon's Trials Count
settings.tooltip: Trials are randomly selected. If hints are enabled, then there will be hints for which trials need to be completed.

settings.name: remake_medallion_trials
settings.label: Medallion-Locked Trials
settings.tooltip: Each trial's barrier room opens only with its medallion (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: shuffle_dungeon_entrances
settings.label: Shuffle Dungeon Entrances
settings.tooltip: Shuffle the pool of dungeon entrances, including Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern, and Gerudo Training Ground. Additionally, the entrances of Deku Tree, Fire Temple and Bottom of the Well are opened for both adult and child. With Dungeon and Ganon selected, all dungeons including Ganon's castle will be shuffled. Thieves' Hideout is controlled by a separate setting.

settings.name: shuffle_overworld_entrances
settings.label: Shuffle Overworld Entrances
settings.tooltip: Shuffle the pool of Overworld entrances, which corresponds to almost all loading zones between Overworld areas. Some entrances are kept unshuffled to avoid issues: - Hyrule Castle Courtyard and Garden entrances - Both Market Back Alley entrances The entrance from Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia is a one-way entrance and has its own setting below. Just like when shuffling interior entrances, shuffling overworld entrances disables trade timers and trade items never revert, even when dying or loading a save.

settings.name: shuffle_gerudo_valley_river_exit
settings.label: Shuffle Gerudo Valley River Exit
settings.tooltip: Randomize where the one-way entrance down the river in Gerudo Valley leads to.

settings.name: owl_drops
settings.label: Randomize Owl Drops
settings.tooltip: Randomize where Kaepora Gaebora (the Owl) drops you at when you talk to him at Lake Hylia or at the top of Death Mountain Trail.

settings.name: warp_songs
settings.label: Randomize Warp Song Destinations
settings.tooltip: Randomize where each of the 6 warp songs leads to.

settings.name: spawn_positions
settings.label: Randomize Overworld Spawns
settings.tooltip: Randomize where you start when loading a save in the Overworld. This means you may not necessarily spawn inside Link's House or Temple of Time. 'Child': Child overworld spawn will be randomized. 'Adult': Adult overworld spawn will be randomized. Selecting both options will randomize both spawns. This stays consistent after saving and loading the game again.

settings.name: remake_enemizer
settings.label: Enemy Randomizer
settings.tooltip: Enemies swap with others their area already has, only where the logic still holds.

settings.name: remake_enemizer_vanilla
settings.label: Enemies the Randomizer Leaves Alone
settings.tooltip: These enemies stay where they are and replace no other enemy (OoT3D Randomizer's enemy list, "Vanilla").

settings.name: triforce_hunt
settings.label: Triforce Hunt
settings.tooltip: Pieces of the Triforce have been scattered around the world. Find some of them to beat the game. Game is saved on completion, and Ganon's Castle key is given if beating the game again is desired.

settings.name: triforce_count_per_world
settings.label: Triforces Per World
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Triforce Pieces placed in each world. Each world will have the same number of triforces. A good number to choose is 1.5 times the amount of Triforce Pieces required per world, for example 30 Triforces placed with a goal of 20. Higher ratios will result in easier and shorter seeds, while a ratio closer to 1 will generally be longer and more difficult.

settings.name: triforce_goal_per_world
settings.label: Required Triforces Per World
settings.tooltip: Select the amount of Triforce Pieces required to beat the game. In multiworld, the required amount will be per world collectively. For example, if this is set to 20 in a 2 player multiworld, players need 40 total, but one player could obtain 30 and the other 10.

settings.name: shuffle_song_items
settings.label: Shuffle Songs
settings.tooltip: This restricts where song items can appear. 'Song Locations': Song will only appear at locations that normally teach songs. In Multiworld, songs will only appear in their own world. 'Dungeon Rewards': Songs appear at the end of dungeons. For major dungeons, they will be at the boss heart container location. The remaining 4 songs are placed at: - Zelda's Lullaby Location - Ice Cavern's Serenade of Water Location - Bottom of the Well's Lens of Truth Location - Gerudo Training Ground's Ice Arrow Location If some dungeons are pre-completed, songs that would have been located inside these dungeons are given for free along with the free dungeon rewards. 'Anywhere': Songs can appear in any location.

settings.name: remake_vanilla_songs
settings.label: Songs Stay Vanilla
settings.tooltip: Every song is taught where the vanilla game teaches it (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Songs: Off). Needs songs on song locations.

settings.name: shopsanity
settings.label: Shopsanity
settings.tooltip: Randomizes Shop contents. 'X Items Per Shop': Each shop will have the specified number of items randomized and they will always appear on the left side (identified by the Special Deal! text). Remaining items will be shuffled between shops. 'Random # of Items Per Shop': Each shop will have 0 to 4 Special Deals. The randomized items have no requirements except money, while the remaining items retain normal requirements. Tunics that aren't a Special Deal! will still require you to be an adult to purchase for example. Bombchu Special Deals will unlock the Bombchu slot in your inventory and allow purchase of Bombchu Refills if "Bombchus are considered in logic" is enabled. Otherwise, the Bomb Bag is required to purchase Bombchu Refills.

settings.name: special_deal_price_distribution
settings.label: Special Deal Prices
settings.tooltip: Controls how the prices for Special Deal items in shops are selected. For more control, utilize the plandomizer. 'Vanilla': Each item will be sold for the price of the item that appears in its slot in the vanilla game. 'Weighted': Shop prices will be biased towards slightly below the middle of the selected range, with very low or very high prices only appearing rarely. 'Uniform': Each price value in the selected range is equally likely.

settings.name: special_deal_price_min
settings.label: Minimum Special Deal Price
settings.tooltip: Select the minimum price in rupees for Special Deal items in shops. Prices will be selected randomly in multiples of 5 according to the "Special Deal Price Distribution" setting. Set this setting and "Maximum Special Deal Price" to the same value to give all Special Deals a fixed price.

settings.name: special_deal_price_max
settings.label: Maximum Special Deal Price
settings.tooltip: Select the maximum price in rupees for Special Deal items in shops. Prices will be selected randomly in multiples of 5 according to the "Special Deal Price Distribution" setting. Set this setting and "Minimum Special Deal Price" to the same value to give all Special Deals a fixed price.

settings.name: remake_shop_prices
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Prices
settings.tooltip: Ship of Harkinian's and OoT3D Randomizer's price modes. Balanced and the "up to" modes favour cheap prices; by wallet weights draws how often a price needs no wallet, the child's, the adult's or the giant's wallet. Every price is 0-500.

settings.name: remake_shop_price_fixed
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Fixed Price
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Fixed).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_range_1
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Range From
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Range).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_range_2
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Range To
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Range).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_weight_none
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Weight, Free
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_weight_child
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Weight, Child's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_weight_adult
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Weight, Adult's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_shop_price_weight_giant
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Weight, Giant's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_shop_prices_affordable
settings.label: Shop Special Deals: Affordable
settings.tooltip: Each price drops to the cheapest of its wallet tier: 5, 100 or 205 rupees (Ship of Harkinian; not with a fixed price).

settings.name: remake_shop_shields_tunics_after_found
settings.label: Shops Sell Shields and Tunics Only Once Found
settings.tooltip: Shields and tunics appear in shops only after you've found one (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_split_potion_shops
settings.label: Shuffle Both Potion Shops
settings.tooltip: The Market's and Kakariko's potion shops each get their own shuffled shelves.

settings.name: tokensanity
settings.label: Tokensanity
settings.tooltip: Token reward from Gold Skulltulas are shuffled into the pool. 'Dungeons Only': This only shuffles the GS locations that are within dungeons, increasing the value of most dungeons and making internal dungeon exploration more diverse. 'Overworld Only': This only shuffles the GS locations that are outside of dungeons. 'All Tokens': Effectively adds 100 new locations for items to appear.

settings.name: remake_gs_positions
settings.label: Gold Skulltula Positions
settings.tooltip: Gold Skulltulas that can move take another spot of their area (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: shuffle_scrubs
settings.label: Scrub Shuffle
settings.tooltip: 'Off': Only the 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the vanilla game (PoH, Deku Nut capacity, and Deku Stick capacity) will have random items. 'Affordable': All Scrub prices will be reduced to 10 rupees each. 'Expensive': All Scrub prices will be their vanilla prices. This will require spending over 1000 rupees on Scrubs. 'Random Prices': All Scrub prices will be between 0-99 rupees. This will on average be very, very expensive overall.

settings.name: remake_scrub_prices
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Prices
settings.tooltip: Ship of Harkinian's and OoT3D Randomizer's price modes. Balanced and the "up to" modes favour cheap prices; by wallet weights draws how often a price needs no wallet, the child's, the adult's or the giant's wallet. Every price is 0-500.

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_fixed
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Fixed Price
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Fixed).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_range_1
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Range From
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Range).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_range_2
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Range To
settings.tooltip: Rupees, 0-500 (mode Range).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_weight_none
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Weight, Free
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_weight_child
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Weight, Child's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_weight_adult
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Weight, Adult's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_scrub_price_weight_giant
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Weight, Giant's Wallet
settings.tooltip: 0-100 (mode By wallet weights).

settings.name: remake_scrub_prices_affordable
settings.label: Business Scrubs: Affordable
settings.tooltip: Each price drops to the cheapest of its wallet tier: 5, 100 or 205 rupees (Ship of Harkinian; not with a fixed price).

settings.name: shuffle_child_trade
settings.label: Shuffle Child Trade Sequence Items
settings.tooltip: Select the items to shuffle in the child trade sequence. To skip Child Zelda, do not shuffle Zelda's Letter and add it as a starting item.

settings.name: adult_trade_shuffle
settings.label: Shuffle All Selected Adult Trade Items
settings.tooltip: Enable to shuffle every selected Adult Trade Item. If disabled and at least one of "Shuffle Adult Trade Sequence Items" is selected, Anju will always give a shuffled item even if Pocket Egg has not been shuffled.

settings.name: adult_trade_start
settings.label: Shuffle Adult Trade Sequence Items
settings.tooltip: Select the Adult Trade Sequence items to shuffle. If "Shuffle All Selected Adult Trade Items" is enabled, every selected item will be shuffled. If "Shuffle All Selected Adult Trade Items" is disabled, only one of the selected items will be shuffled. If the Odd Mushroom, Eyeball Frog, or Eyedrops is removed from the player's inventory due to an expired timer or game reset, that item can be reacquired from its non-shuffled location.

settings.name: shuffle_freestanding_items
settings.label: Shuffle Rupees & Hearts
settings.tooltip: Shuffles freestanding rupees and recovery hearts, also shuffles: Shadow Temple Spinning Pot Drop All Goron Pot faces Off: No freestanding rupees/recovery hearts are shuffled. All: All Visible freestanding rupees/recovery hearts are shuffled. Overworld Only: Freestanding rupees/recovery hearts in the overworld are shuffled. Dungeons Only: Freestanding rupees/recovery hearts in dungeons are shuffled.

settings.name: remake_vanilla_freestanding_rupees
settings.label: Freestanding Rupees Stay Vanilla
settings.tooltip: With freestanding items shuffled, the rupees lying around stay rupees (OoT3D Randomizer's Shuffle Standing Rupees: Off).

settings.name: remake_vanilla_freestanding_hearts
settings.label: Recovery Hearts Stay Vanilla
settings.tooltip: With freestanding items shuffled, the recovery hearts lying around stay hearts (OoT3D Randomizer's Shuffle Recovery Hearts: Off).

settings.name: remake_touch_pickups
settings.label: Auto-Collected Rupees and Hearts
settings.tooltip: Rupees and hearts collected by touch (Zora's Fountain, Dampe's race...) can hold any item.

settings.name: remake_freestanding_keys
settings.label: Bottom of the Well and Shadow Temple Floor Keys
settings.tooltip: The small keys lying on the floor in the Bottom of the Well and the Shadow Temple. 'Hold any item': each gives the seed's item when picked up; 'Stay keys': they stay their dungeon's keys.

settings.name: remake_gc_pot_prize
settings.label: Goron City Spinning Pot Prize
settings.tooltip: The prize of Goron City's big spinning pot (OoTR's GC Pot Freestanding PoH). 'Any item': it gives the seed's item, held up; 'Its heart piece': it stays the heart piece.

settings.name: remake_zd_grotto_rupees
settings.label: Zora's Domain Grotto Rupees
settings.tooltip: The six blue rupees in the Zora's Domain Song of Storms grotto.

settings.name: shuffle_pots
settings.label: Shuffle Pots
settings.tooltip: Shuffles pots, flying pots into the location pool. Off: Not shuffled. All: All pots/flying pots are shuffled. Overworld Only: Only overworld pots/flying pots are shuffled. Dungeons Only: Only dungeon pots/flying pots are shuffled. When this setting is enabled, the pots in Ganon's Tower will be accessible without Ganon's Boss Key. Proceeding up the tower out of the room with the pots will require Ganon's Boss Key.

settings.name: shuffle_empty_pots
settings.label: Include Empty Pots
settings.tooltip: Enabling this will include empty pots into the location pool based on the Shuffle Pots setting chosen.

settings.name: shuffle_crates
settings.label: Shuffle Crates
settings.tooltip: Shuffles large and small crates into the location pool. Off: Not shuffled. All: crates are shuffled. Overworld Only: Only overworld crates are shuffled. Dungeons Only: Only dungeon crates are shuffled. Note: Only crates which normally drop an item are shuffled. Empty crates are not included.

settings.name: shuffle_empty_crates
settings.label: Include Empty Crates
settings.tooltip: Enabling this will include empty crates into the location pool based on the Shuffle Crates setting chosen.

settings.name: remake_reset_group_objects
settings.label: Pots That Refill with the Room
settings.tooltip: Pots and crates the game refills together (dungeons, Kakariko, the Market). "Hold any item" lets them hold anything, as OoTR's pot checks; "Hold junk only" keeps the game's refills and gives them junk.

settings.name: remake_empty_object_contents
settings.label: Empty Pots and Crates Give
settings.tooltip: What a shuffled pot or crate that OoTR leaves empty ("Nothing") gives.

settings.name: shuffle_cows
settings.label: Shuffle Cows
settings.tooltip: Enabling this will let cows give you items upon performing Epona's song in front of them. The remake has 8 cows: 7 of the original's (Link's house, the Hyrule Field and Death Mountain Trail cow grottos, the two Lon Lon Ranch stable cows, Impa's house and Gerudo Valley) and its own new cow in Gerudo's Fortress, by the horseback archery stable (adult; the guard on the way there wants the Gerudo Membership Card). The two in the Lon Lon Ranch tower aren't in the remake.

settings.name: shuffle_beehives
settings.label: Shuffle Beehives
settings.tooltip: Enabling this will let beehives drop items. The remake has 7 beehives, all in the grotto under the lid next to Kakariko's House of Skulltula, and child and adult each find their own 7: 14 in all. The logic counts every way the remake breaks them: the Boomerang, the Hookshot, the Bow and Din's Fire. The Slingshot can't, unless Slingshot Breaks Beehives is on.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_grass
settings.label: Shuffle Grass
settings.tooltip: Grass tufts and bushes hold items (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Grass). A tuft keeps growing back with its item until you take it; after that it's normal grass.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_rocks
settings.label: Shuffle Small Rocks
settings.tooltip: Small rocks you can lift hold items (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Rocks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_boulders
settings.label: Shuffle Boulders and Silver Rocks
settings.tooltip: Bomb boulders, bronze (hammer) boulders and silver rocks hold items. They never come back in vanilla: one whose item you left behind is back on your next visit with it.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_bushes
settings.label: Shuffle Bushes
settings.tooltip: The 13 bushes in Hyrule Field hold items (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Bushes). Cut one with a sword, the Boomerang or the hammer; after its item is taken it's a normal bush.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_trees
settings.label: Shuffle Trees
settings.tooltip: Rolling into a tree drops an item (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Trees).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_icicles
settings.label: Shuffle Icicles
settings.tooltip: Falling icicles hold items (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Icicles).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_red_ice
settings.label: Shuffle Red Ice
settings.tooltip: Red ice melted with blue fire holds items (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Red Ice).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_misc
settings.label: Shuffle Palm Fruit and Decorations
settings.tooltip: Gerudo Valley palm fruit, cow skulls and sign decorations hold items.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_signs
settings.label: Shuffle Signs
settings.tooltip: Reading a sign, tablet or grave the first time gives an item (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Signs: 35 spots).

settings.name: remake_drop_contents
settings.label: What Shuffled Objects May Hold
settings.tooltip: "Anything" is OoTR's and Ship of Harkinian's: an object comes back with its item until you take it.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_stone_fairies
settings.label: Shuffle Gossip Stone Fairies
settings.tooltip: Playing a song for a Gossip Stone gives an item along with its fairy: one for Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, the Sun's Song or the Song of Time, another for the Song of Storms (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Stone Fairies: 80 checks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_fountain_fairies
settings.label: Shuffle Fairy Fountains
settings.tooltip: The Desert Colossus oasis, the Hyrule Field, Sacred Forest Meadow and Zora's River fairy grottos and the Graveyard's fairy grave give items: the oasis after its Song of Storms scene, a grotto or the grave the first time you drop in (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Fountain Fairies: 39 checks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_bean_fairies
settings.label: Shuffle Bean Plant Fairies
settings.tooltip: Playing the Song of Storms over a planted bean (as a child) gives three items along with its fairy (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Bean Fairies: 30 checks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_song_fairies
settings.label: Shuffle Fairy Note Spots
settings.tooltip: Playing the Sun's Song or the Song of Storms at a Fairy Note gives an item along with its fairy (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Song Fairies: 9 checks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_butterfly_fairies
settings.label: Shuffle Butterfly Fairies
settings.tooltip: The butterflies that turn into a fairy at a child's Deku Stick drop an item instead (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Butterfly Fairies: 15 checks).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_big_poes
settings.label: Shuffle Big Poes
settings.tooltip: Each of Hyrule Field's ten Big Poes gives an item when its soul is bottled (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_fire_gorons
settings.label: Shuffle Fire Temple Gorons
settings.tooltip: Each freed Goron in the Fire Temple gives an item after his thank-you (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: shuffle_wonderitems
settings.label: Shuffle Wonderitems
settings.tooltip: In the original game, wonder items are invisible items that drop something when Link touches a spot or hits it (OoTR's Shuffle Wonderitems). The remake doesn't use them, so this setting has nothing to shuffle and changes nothing.

settings.name: remake_wonderitems_area
settings.label: Wonderitems Shuffled In
settings.tooltip: Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Wonder Items: where wonderitems hold seed items. The remake has no wonderitems, so this changes nothing.

settings.name: shuffle_kokiri_sword
settings.label: Shuffle Kokiri Sword
settings.tooltip: Enabling this shuffles the Kokiri Sword into the pool. This will require extensive use of sticks until the sword is found.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_master_sword
settings.label: Shuffle the Master Sword
settings.tooltip: The Master Sword is an item somewhere in the world: pulling it from the pedestal needs it.

settings.name: remake_progressive_swords
settings.label: Progressive Swords
settings.tooltip: Kokiri Sword, Master Sword, Giant's Knife, Biggoron Sword in that order. Needs the Master Sword shuffled.

settings.name: remake_progressive_goron_sword
settings.label: Progressive Goron Sword
settings.tooltip: Giant's Knife then Biggoron Sword (Ship of Harkinian / OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: shuffle_ocarinas
settings.label: Shuffle Ocarinas
settings.tooltip: Enabling this shuffles the Fairy Ocarina and the Ocarina of Time into the pool. This will require finding an Ocarina before being able to play songs.

settings.name: shuffle_gerudo_card
settings.label: Shuffle Gerudo Card

settings.name: remake_shuffle_deku_stick_bag
settings.label: Shuffle the Deku Stick Bag
settings.tooltip: You can't carry Deku Sticks until you find the bag (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_deku_nut_bag

settings.name: remake_shuffle_child_wallet

settings.name: remake_ammo_without_container

settings.name: shuffle_beans

settings.name: remake_shuffle_bean_souls

settings.name: shuffle_frog_song_rupees
settings.label: Shuffle Frog Song Rupees
settings.tooltip: Enabling this adds 5 Purple Rupees to the item pool and shuffles the rewards from playing Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Sun's Song, and Song of Time to the frogs in Zora's River.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_bowling_bombchus
settings.label: Shuffle Bombchu Bowling's Bombchus
settings.tooltip: Bombchu Bowling's bombchu prize is shuffled too.

settings.name: shuffle_100_skulltula_rupee
settings.label: Shuffle 100 Skulltula Reward
settings.tooltip: Enabling this adds the repeatable Huge Rupee reward from the Skulltula house to the item pool. This is obtained by collecting all 100 gold skulltulas.

settings.name: shuffle_loach_reward
settings.label: Shuffle Hyrule Loach Reward
settings.tooltip: Enabling this shuffles the reward for catching the Hyrule Loach at the fishing pond into the item pool Vanilla Behavior shuffles the reward for catching the loach but otherwise keeps all behavior the same as in the vanilla game. The loach will spawn every fourth play of the fishing minigame and the sinking lure will become available only after obtaining the fishing prize for link's current age. Easier Behavior shuffles the loach reward but also modifies some behavior in order to make the loach easier to catch. When enabled the loach will always spawn at the fishing pond, the sinking lure will be available immediately at all four possible positions, and the child/adult fishing prizes are still obtainable if you use the sinking lure.

settings.name: remake_fishsanity
settings.label: Fishsanity
settings.tooltip: Fish hold items: the fishing pond's fish (show one to the owner) and the fish in Zora's Domain (net one with a bottle). Ship of Harkinian's Fishsanity.

settings.name: remake_fishsanity_pond_count
settings.label: Pond Fish with Items
settings.tooltip: How many of the pond's 17 fish hold items.

settings.name: remake_fishsanity_age_split
settings.label: Child and Adult Pond Fish Apart
settings.tooltip: The pond's fish are separate checks as a child and as an adult.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_fishing_pole
settings.label: Shuffle the Fishing Pole
settings.tooltip: The pond owner rents no rod until you find the Fishing Pole (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_shuffle_fishermans_hat
settings.label: Shuffle the Fishing Pond Owner's Hat
settings.tooltip: Giving the pond owner's hat back gives an item (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: shuffle_dungeon_rewards
settings.label: Shuffle Dungeon Rewards
settings.tooltip: This controls where Medallions and Spiritual Stones can appear. 'Vanilla Locations': Medallions and Spiritual Stones will appear in their vanilla locations. 'Dungeon Reward Locations': Medallions and Spiritual Stones will be awarded when stepping into the blue warps of boss rooms, but not necessarily the boss's vanilla reward. In Multiworld, dungeon rewards will only appear in their own world. If you use one of the following options, note that after receiving the last required medallion for the Burning Kakariko cutscene while already in Kakariko, the cutscene doesn't play until you leave and reenter Kakariko (or enter and exit a building). 'Own Dungeon': Each dungeon reward appears in its respective dungeon, but not necessarily on the boss. If boss entrances are mixed, boss rooms that aren't in a dungeon can't have dungeon rewards. The Light Medallion appears in the Temple of Time, or may be a starting item if the "Free Reward from Rauru" setting is enabled. 'Regional': Dungeon rewards can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Dungeon rewards can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Dungeon rewards can only appear inside of dungeons. 'Anywhere': Dungeon rewards can appear anywhere in the world.

settings.name: remake_links_pocket
settings.label: Link's Pocket
settings.tooltip: What Rauru's reward in the Chamber of Sages is (with "skip Rauru's reward" free, you start with it). Anything but OoTR's rules needs the rewards shuffled (Ship of Harkinian / OoT3D Randomizer's Link's Pocket).

settings.name: remake_links_pocket_reward
settings.label: Link's Pocket Reward
settings.tooltip: Which reward Link's Pocket holds when it holds one (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: shuffle_map
settings.label: Maps
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': Maps are removed. This will add a small amount of money and refill items to the pool. 'Start With': Maps are given to you from the start. This will add a small amount of money and refill items to the pool. 'Vanilla': Maps will appear in their vanilla locations. 'Own Dungeon': Maps can only appear in their respective dungeon. 'Regional': Maps can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Maps can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Maps can only appear in a dungeon, but not necessarily the dungeon they are for. 'Anywhere': Maps can appear anywhere in the world. Setting 'Remove', 'Start With', 'Overworld', or 'Anywhere' will add 1 more possible location to each Dungeon. This makes dungeons more profitable, especially Ice Cavern, Water Temple, and Jabu Jabu's Belly. Regardless of the selected option, maps from pre-completed dungeons won't be placed outside their respective dungeons and maps from other dungeons won't be placed inside pre-completed dungeons.

settings.name: shuffle_compass
settings.label: Compasses
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': Compasses are removed. This will add a small amount of money and refill items to the pool. 'Start With': Compasses are given to you from the start. This will add a small amount of money and refill items to the pool. 'Vanilla': Compasses will appear in their vanilla locations. 'Own Dungeon': Compasses can only appear in their respective dungeon. 'Regional': Compasses can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Compasses can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Compasses can only appear in a dungeon, but not necessarily the dungeon they are for. 'Anywhere': Compasses can appear anywhere in the world. Setting 'Remove', 'Start With', 'Overworld', or 'Anywhere' will add 1 more possible location to each Dungeon. This makes dungeons more profitable, especially Ice Cavern, Water Temple, and Jabu Jabu's Belly. Regardless of the selected option, compasses from pre-completed dungeons won't be placed outside their respective dungeons and compasses from other dungeons won't be placed inside pre-completed dungeons.

settings.name: shuffle_smallkeys
settings.label: Small Keys
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': Small Keys are removed. All locked doors in dungeons will be unlocked. An easier mode. 'Vanilla': Small Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. You start with 3 keys in Spirit Temple MQ because the vanilla key layout is not beatable in logic. You start with 2 keys in Vanilla/MQ Shadow Temple with its dungeon shortcut enabled to prevent softlocks. 'Own Dungeon': Small Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. If Fire Temple is not a Master Quest dungeon, the door to the Boss Key chest will be unlocked. 'Regional': Small Keys can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Small Keys can only appear outside of dungeons. You may need to enter a dungeon multiple times to gain items to access the overworld locations with the keys required to finish a dungeon. 'Any Dungeon': Small Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon, but won't necessarily be in the dungeon that the key is for. A difficult mode since it is more likely to need to enter a dungeon multiple times. 'Anywhere': Small Keys can appear anywhere in the world. A difficult mode since it is more likely to need to enter a dungeon multiple times. Try different combination out, such as: 'Small Keys: Dungeon' + 'Boss Keys: Anywhere' for a milder Keysanity experience. Regardless of the selected option, small keys from pre-completed dungeons won't be placed outside their respective dungeons and small keys from other dungeons won't be placed inside pre-completed dungeons.

settings.name: shuffle_hideoutkeys
settings.label: Thieves' Hideout Keys
settings.tooltip: "Vanilla": Thieves' Hideout Keys will appear in their vanilla location, dropping from fighting Gerudo guards that attack when trying to free the jailed carpenters. "Gerudo Fortress Region": Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear in Gerudo Fortress or Thieves' Hideout. "Regional": Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear in Gerudo Valley, Gerudo Fortress, Thieves' Hideout, Gerudo Training Ground, Haunted Wasteland, Desert Colossus, or Spirit Temple. "Overworld Only": Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear outside of dungeons. "Any Dungeon": Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear inside of dungeons. "Anywhere": Thieves' Hideout Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

settings.name: shuffle_tcgkeys
settings.label: Treasure Chest Game Keys
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': All Treasure Chest Game keys will be removed and all doors will remained unlocked. 'Vanilla': Treasure Chest Game keys will have vanilla behavior (one random per room). The minigame will also have vanilla behavior. 'Regional': Treasure Chest Game keys can only appear in Hyrule Field, Lon Lon Ranch, the Market, the Temple of Time, Hyrule Castle, outside Ganon's Castle, or inside Ganon's Castle. 'Overworld Only': Treasure Chest Game keys can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Treasure Chest Game keys can only appear inside of dungeons. 'Anywhere': Treasure Chest Game keys can appear anywhere in the world.

settings.name: key_rings_choice
settings.label: Key Rings Mode
settings.tooltip: Selected dungeons will have all of their keys found at once in a ring rather than individually. For example, instead of shuffling 5 Forest Temple small keys into the pool, you will find a single key ring which will give you all 5 keys at once. Selecting key ring for dungeons will have no effect if Small Keys are set to Remove or Vanilla. Selecting key ring for Thieves' Hideout will have no effect if Thieves' Hideout keys are in vanilla locations or Gerudo's Fortress is set to Rescue One Carpenter. Similarly, selecting Treasure Chest Game will have no effect if the keys aren't shuffled. Treasure Chest Game will be considered when selecting 'All dungeons' or 'Random selection'.

settings.label: Key Rings
settings.tooltip: Select areas with keyring instead of multiple keys

settings.name: keyring_give_bk
settings.label: Key Rings give Boss Keys
settings.tooltip: Boss Keys will be included in the Key Ring for the specific dungeon. This does not apply to the Ganon's Castle Boss Key.

settings.name: remake_skeleton_key
settings.label: Skeleton Key
settings.tooltip: One extra item that opens every small-key door in every dungeon and the Thieves' Hideout (Ship of Harkinian's Skeleton Key).

settings.name: shuffle_bosskeys
settings.label: Boss Keys
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': Boss Keys are removed. All locked doors in dungeons will be unlocked. An easier mode. 'Vanilla': Boss Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. 'Own Dungeon': Boss Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. 'Regional': Boss Keys can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Boss Keys can only appear outside of dungeons. You may need to enter a dungeon without the boss key to get items required to find the key in the overworld. 'Any Dungeon': Boss Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon, but won't necessarily be in the dungeon that the key is for. A difficult mode since it is more likely to need to enter a dungeon multiple times. 'Anywhere': Boss Keys can appear anywhere in the world. A difficult mode since it is more likely to need to enter a dungeon multiple times. Try different combinations out, such as: 'Small Keys: Dungeon' + 'Boss Keys: Anywhere' for a milder Keysanity experience. Regardless of the selected option, boss keys from pre-completed dungeons won't be placed outside their respective dungeons and boss keys from other dungeons won't be placed inside pre-completed dungeons.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_boss_souls
settings.label: Shuffle Boss Souls
settings.tooltip: Each dungeon boss can only be fought once you find its soul (Ship of Harkinian's Shuffle Boss Souls). Without it, entering its arena sends you back to the dungeon's entrance.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_enemy_souls
settings.label: Shuffle Enemy Souls
settings.tooltip: Enemies only appear once you find their soul (as the OotrR remake randomizer's enemy souls). All enemies: one soul for each kind of enemy, plus every boss's soul. Regional: one soul for each area, which also lets you fight its dungeon's boss. A room that shuts you in until its enemies are beaten stays open without their soul, and the logic asks for the souls a dungeon's puzzles and a guarded chest need. For boss souls only, use Shuffle Boss Souls.

settings.name: shuffle_ganon_bosskey
settings.label: Ganon's Boss Key
settings.tooltip: 'Remove': Ganon's Castle Boss Key is removed and the boss door in Ganon's Tower starts unlocked. 'Vanilla': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will appear in the vanilla location. 'Own Dungeon': Ganon's Castle Boss Key can only appear inside Ganon's Castle. 'Regional': Ganon's Castle Boss Key can only appear in Hyrule Field, Lon Lon Ranch, Market, Temple of Time, Hyrule Castle, (Outside) Ganon's Castle, and Inside Ganon's Castle. 'Overworld Only': Ganon's Castle Boss Key can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Ganon's Castle Boss Key can only appear inside of a dungeon, but not necessarily Ganon's Castle. 'Anywhere': Ganon's Castle Boss Key can appear anywhere in the world. 'Light Arrow Cutscene': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will appear on the Light Arrow Cutscene. 'Stones': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will be awarded when reaching the target number of Spiritual Stones. 'Medallions': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will be awarded when reaching the target number of Medallions. 'Dungeon Rewards': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will be awarded when reaching the target number of Dungeon Rewards. 'Tokens': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will be awarded when reaching the target number of Gold Skulltula Tokens. 'Hearts': Ganon's Castle Boss Key will be awarded when reaching the target number of hearts.

settings.label: Ganon's Soul
settings.tooltip: The door to Ganondorf opens only once you hold enough of these (Ship of Harkinian's Ganon's Soul).

settings.name: remake_ganons_soul_count
settings.label: Ganon's Soul Count
settings.tooltip: How many are needed: up to 3 Spiritual Stones, 6 Medallions, 9 dungeon rewards, 100 tokens, or 4-20 hearts. 0: all of that kind.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_ganons_soul
settings.label: Ganon's Soul as an Item
settings.tooltip: The door to Ganondorf opens only once you find Ganon's Soul somewhere in the world (Ship of Harkinian's Ganon's Soul, Anywhere). Not with the count version.

settings.name: shuffle_silver_rupees
settings.label: Shuffle Silver Rupees
settings.tooltip: Enabling this shuffles the Silver Rupee puzzles into to the item pool. Silver Rupees are grouped into sets of 5 (except for some Master Quest dungeons, which have sets of other amounts), each of which permanently unlocks something in a dungeon once all the rupees in that set are collected. Hints will only tell you the dungeon a Silver Rupee corresponds to, but upon collecting it, you will be told the exact room. The vanilla locations of Silver Rupees hold shuffled items. 'Remove': Silver Rupees are removed and the puzzles are solved. This will add a small amount of money and refill items to the pool. 'Vanilla': Silver Rupees will appear in their vanilla locations. You will have to collect all of a set in one go to to solve a puzzle. 'Own Dungeon': Silver Rupees can only appear in their respective dungeon. 'Regional': Silver Rupees can only appear in regions near the original dungeon (including the dungeon itself or other dungeons in the region). The Wiki has a list of corresponding regions here. 'Overworld Only': Silver Rupees can only appear outside of dungeons. 'Any Dungeon': Silver Rupees can only appear in a dungeon, but not necessarily the dungeon they are for. 'Anywhere': Silver Rupees can appear anywhere in the world.

settings.name: silver_rupee_pouches_choice
settings.label: Silver Rupee Pouches Mode
settings.tooltip: Selected silver rupee puzzles will have all of their silver rupees found at once in a pouch rather than individually. For example, instead of shuffling 5 silver rupees for the Fire Trial in Ganon's Castle into the pool, you will find a single pouch which will give you all 5 of them at once.

settings.name: silver_rupee_pouches
settings.label: Silver Rupee Pouches

settings.name: reachable_locations
settings.label: Guarantee Reachable Locations
settings.tooltip: This determines which items and locations are guaranteed to be reachable. 'All': The randomizer will guarantee that every item is obtainable and every location is reachable. 'All Goals': The randomizer will guarantee that every goal item is obtainable, not just the amount required to beat the game, but otherwise behaves like 'Required Only'. Goal items are the items required for the rainbow bridge and/or Ganon's Boss Key, so for example if the bridge is set to 1 Medallion and Ganon's Boss Key to 1 Gold Skulltula Token, all 6 Medallions and all 100 Tokens will be obtainable. In Triforce Hunt, this will instead guarantee that all Triforce Pieces can be obtained. Hint distributions that define custom goals or remove the default goals will affect item placement as well. 'Required Only': Only items and locations required to beat the game will be guaranteed reachable.

settings.name: logic_no_night_tokens_without_suns_song

settings.tooltip: GS Tokens that can only be obtained during the night expect you to have Sun's Song to collect them. This prevents needing to wait until night for some locations.

Locations in the right column will never have items that are required to complete the game, and will only contain junk. Most dungeon locations have a MQ alternative. If the location does not exist because of MQ then it will be ignored. So make sure to disable both versions if that is the intent.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_jsc
settings.label: Infinite Jump Slash Cancel (IJSC)
settings.tooltip: Link climbs to almost any height by chaining jump attacks through the item menu: Deku Sticks as a child, the Megaton Hammer as an adult, plus any second item to swap to. He can't go higher than his last normal jump. In logic: Kokiri Forest, Kakariko Village, Graveyard, Zora's River, Zora's Domain, Lake Hylia, Gerudo Valley, Gerudo's Fortress, Desert Colossus, Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Shadow Temple, Ganon's Castle (28 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_actor_jump
settings.label: Actor Jump
settings.tooltip: An adult is launched high into the air off a movable object (an open chest, a gravestone, a bean plant) by jumping just as an aimed Hookshot, Bow or Ocarina animation ends. In logic: Graveyard, Gerudo's Fortress, Desert Colossus (4 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_bomb_pose_clip
settings.label: Bomb Pose clip (Forest Temple)
settings.tooltip: An adult clips through Forest Temple walls with the Bomb Pose (Ocarina and Bombs) and a save and reload: past the Song of Time block, into the Bow room, and through the well with the Iron Boots. In logic: Forest Temple (3 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_child_shadow
settings.label: Child Shadow Temple (Puberty Skip)
settings.tooltip: A child does the Shadow Temple with jump slash cancels and Din's Fire, and Bongo Bongo's blue warp makes Link an adult without the Master Sword. The randomizer checks such seeds as you'd play them: everything the child can get first, then adult for good (a child again only through the Adult Deku Tree glitch). In logic: Graveyard, Shadow Temple (17 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_adult_deku_tree
settings.label: Adult Deku Tree (Reverse Puberty)
settings.tooltip: An adult jump-slash-cancels onto the Deku Tree with the Megaton Hammer, and Gohma's blue warp (once she is beaten) always makes Link a child again. In logic: Kokiri Forest, Deku Tree (3 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_gf_skip
settings.label: Gerudo Card skip
settings.tooltip: An adult gets past the Gerudo Fortress gate without the Gerudo Card: an Actor Jump off the roof chest, or a jump slash cancel with the Hover Boots. In logic: Gerudo's Fortress (2 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_infinite_hover
settings.label: Infinite Hover Boots
settings.tooltip: An adult keeps the Hover Boots hovering by using an empty bottle as they kick in, close to the ground only. In logic: Ganon's Castle (1 route). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_collapse_hookshot
settings.label: Tower collapse with the Hookshot
settings.tooltip: In the tower collapse, an adult reaches with the plain Hookshot the spot the remake made need the Longshot (die once on the lower level, then jump-slash-cancel back up with the Megaton Hammer). In logic: Ganon's Tower (1 route). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_kz_stick_lift
settings.label: King Zora skip
settings.tooltip: A child jump-slash-cancels over King Zora with Deku Sticks to Zora's Fountain, without Ruto's Letter. In logic: Zora's Domain (2 routes). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_dc_skip
settings.label: Dodongo's Cavern early Bomb Bag
settings.tooltip: A child jump-slash-cancels from the cavern's lobby straight up to the Bomb Bag chest. In logic: Dodongo's Cavern (1 route). Glitched logic includes it.

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_spirit_hand_entry
settings.label: Spirit Temple through the Mirror Shield hand (not in logic yet)
settings.tooltip: An adult on the Colossus's right hand walks into the temple through the hand's doorway. Not in logic yet: none of its routes has been done in the remake, so turning it on changes no seed until one is (1 to try in the game).

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_cucco_displacement
settings.label: Cucco displacement (adult Bottom of the Well) (not in logic yet)
settings.tooltip: Grabbing a Cucco just as it lands in deep water can carry Link through walls: the way into the Bottom of the Well as an adult. Not in logic yet: none of its routes has been done in the remake, so turning it on changes no seed until one is (1 to try in the game).

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_forest_temple_ledge
settings.label: Forest Temple ledge without the Hookshot (not in logic yet)
settings.tooltip: An adult jump-slash-cancels up to the Forest Temple's entrance ledge with the Megaton Hammer. Not in logic yet: none of its routes has been done in the remake, so turning it on changes no seed until one is (1 to try in the game).

settings.name: logic_remake_glitch_gs_dupe
settings.label: Gold Skulltula token duplication (not in logic yet)
settings.tooltip: Saving and reloading at the right moment gives a Gold Skulltula's token again and again (vanilla tokens only). Not in logic yet: none of its routes has been done in the remake, so turning it on changes no seed until one is (6 to try in the game).

settings.label: Starting Hearts
settings.tooltip: Start the game with the selected number of hearts. Above 3, Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart are removed from the item pool in equal proportion. Below 3, Heart Containers are added to the item pool in place of junk, so you can still reach 20 hearts.

settings.name: starting_items

settings.name: skip_reward_from_rauru
settings.label: Free Reward from Rauru
settings.tooltip: The item given by Rauru beyond the Door of Time (the Light Medallion in the vanilla game) is given as a starting item instead. 'No': Rauru gives reward when you go beyond the Door of Time. 'Yes': You begin the game with the reward Rauru normally gives beyond the Door of Time. If dungeon rewards are shuffled then this will be as well. 'Yes (Forced)': You begin the game with the reward Rauru normally gives beyond the Door of Time, if dungeon rewards are shuffled you will still get a random Spiritual Stone or Medallion.

settings.name: no_escape_sequence
settings.label: Skip Tower Escape Sequence
settings.tooltip: The tower escape sequence between Ganondorf and Ganon will be skipped.

settings.name: no_guard_stealth
settings.label: Skip Child Stealth
settings.tooltip: The crawlspace into Hyrule Castle goes straight to Zelda, skipping the guards.

settings.name: no_epona_race
settings.label: Skip Epona Race
settings.tooltip: Epona can be summoned with Epona's Song without needing to race Ingo.

settings.name: remake_skip_talon
settings.label: Skip Waking Talon
settings.tooltip: Talon starts awake at Lon Lon Ranch (Ship of Harkinian). Malon's castle egg is skipped; needs the Weird Egg and Chicken unshuffled.

settings.name: skip_some_minigame_phases
settings.label: Skip Some Minigame Phases
settings.tooltip: Awards all eligible prizes after the first attempt for Dampe Race and Gerudo Horseback Archery. Dampe will start with the second race so you can finish the race in under a minute and get both rewards at once. You still get the first reward from the chest even if you don't complete the race in under a minute. Both rewards at the Gerudo Horseback Archery will be available from the first time you play the minigame. This means you can get both rewards at once if you get 1500 points in a single attempt.

settings.name: complete_mask_quest
settings.label: Complete Mask Quest
settings.tooltip: Once the Happy Mask Shop is opened, all masks will be available to be borrowed.

settings.name: useful_cutscenes
settings.label: Enable Specific Glitch-Useful Cutscenes
settings.tooltip: The cutscenes of the Poes in Forest Temple and Darunia in Fire Temple will not be skipped. These cutscenes are useful in glitched gameplay only and do not provide any timesave for glitchless playthroughs.

settings.name: remake_skip_four_poes
settings.label: Skip the Forest Temple's Four Poes Cutscene
settings.tooltip: The first time you enter the Forest Temple's main hall, the scene of the four Poes taking the flames is skipped; what it changes in the temple still happens (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: remake_skip_lake_owl
settings.label: Skip the Lake Hylia Owl
settings.tooltip: Agreeing to fly with the owl at Lake Hylia skips the flight: you go straight to the landing, or to the owl's shuffled destination (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: fast_chests
settings.label: Fast Chest Cutscenes
settings.tooltip: All chest animations are fast. If disabled, the animation time is slow for major items.

settings.name: remake_skip_song_replays
settings.label: Skip Song Replays
settings.tooltip: A played song takes effect right away; its tune still plays (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: scarecrow_behavior
settings.label: Scarecrow Behavior
settings.tooltip: "Fast" will require setting the same song both as child and adult, but pulling out the Ocarina near a spot at which Pierre can spawn will do so, without needing the song. "Free" removes both the need to set the song first and to play the song to summon Pierre.

settings.name: fast_bunny_hood
settings.label: Fast Bunny Hood
settings.tooltip: The Bunny Hood mask behaves like it does in Majora's Mask and makes you go 1.5× faster.

settings.name: auto_equip_masks
settings.label: Maintain Mask Equips through Scene Changes
settings.tooltip: The remake already keeps a worn mask on through area changes and reloads (time travel takes it off), so this is on by default. Turn it off to bring back the original game's behaviour: a mask comes off at every loading zone and after loading a save.

settings.name: plant_beans
settings.label: Plant Magic Beans
settings.tooltip: Enabling this plants all 10 magic beans in soft soil causing the bean plants to be available as adult. You can still get beans normally.

settings.name: easier_fire_arrow_entry
settings.label: Easier Fire Arrow Entry
settings.tooltip: It is possible to open the Shadow Temple entrance by lighting the torches with Fire Arrows, but can be difficult to light all 24 torches in time. Enabling this setting allows you to reduce the number of torches that need to be lit to open the entrance, making it easier to perform Fire Arrow Entry. Note that this setting does not affect logic. Whether it's used or not, the trick "Shadow Temple Entry with Fire Arrows" must be enabled for it to be in logic.

settings.name: fae_torch_count
settings.label: Fire Arrow Entry Torch Count
settings.tooltip: The entrance to Shadow Temple will open after the chosen number of torches are lit.

settings.name: ruto_already_f1_jabu
settings.label: Ruto Already at F1
settings.tooltip: Ruto in Jabu Jabu's Belly will already be at the top floor. Only applied in the original version of the dungeon, since in Master Quest you don't need to bring Ruto up.

settings.name: fast_shadow_boat
settings.label: Fast Shadow Boat
settings.tooltip: The boat sequence in Shadow Temple will be massively sped up. The two Stalfos will still fall on the boat, but you won't have time to fight them.

settings.name: remake_king_zora_speed
settings.label: King Zora Moves
settings.tooltip: OoT3D Randomizer's King Zora speed.

settings.name: chicken_count_random
settings.label: Random Cucco Count
settings.tooltip: Anju will give a reward for collecting a random number of Cuccos.

settings.name: chicken_count
settings.label: Cucco Count
settings.tooltip: Anju will give a reward for turning in the chosen number of Cuccos.

settings.name: big_poe_count_random
settings.label: Random Big Poe Target Count
settings.tooltip: The Poe buyer will give a reward for turning in a random number of Big Poes.

settings.name: big_poe_count
settings.label: Big Poe Target Count
settings.tooltip: The Poe buyer will give a reward for turning in the chosen number of Big Poes.

settings.name: clearer_hints
settings.label: Clearer Hints
settings.tooltip: The hints provided by Gossip Stones will be very direct if this option is enabled.

settings.name: hints
settings.label: Gossip Stones
settings.tooltip: Gossip Stones can be made to give hints about where items can be found. Different settings can be chosen to decide which item is needed to speak to Gossip Stones. Choosing to stick with the Mask of Truth will make the hints very difficult to obtain. Hints for 'on the way of the hero' are locations that contain items that are required to beat the game.

settings.name: hint_dist
settings.label: Hint Distribution
settings.tooltip: Balanced: Recommended hint spread. Bingo: Hints locations for items required for most bingo goals. Can be made board-specific by entering a Bingosync URL. Chaos!!!: A completely randomized hint distribution with single copies Chaos!!! (no goal hints): Like "Chaos!!!", but without goal hints. Useful for large multiworld seeds. Co-op: Tournament hints used for Season 3 Co-op Tournament Races. DDR Season 2: Hint distribution for DDR Season 2. Important Checks: Hint Distribution important check hints. 6 Path hints 1 each and 34 important check hints at 1 each telling you how many major items are in an area. League: Hint Distribution for the S10 of League. 6 Always, 5 Path, 3 Important Checks, 3 Sometimes, 2 Dual Hints, 30/40/50 skull hints in house of skulltula MW Season 5: Hints used for the Multiworld Tournament Season 5. MW Season 5 (WotH): Hints used for the Multiworld Tournament Season 5. WotH replacing goal hints. Scrubs: Tournament hints used for Scrubs Races. Duplicates of each hint except foolish which are placed at ToT. Skull Mask, Ice Cavern Final Room, Frogs Rewards and Castle Great Fairies are always hinted, 5 Path (no path priority), 4 Foolish (2 Dungeons), 8 sometimes (2 Dual), HC(Storms) & HF(Cow Grotto) junked. SGL 2026: Hint distribution used for SGL 2026. Strong: More useful hints. Tournament: Hint Distribution for the S9 Tournament: 5 Always, 5 Goal, 2 Barren, 2 Important Check, 1 Song, 2 Dual, 3 Sometimes; House of Skulltula (30/40/50), Light Arrows at Dampe Diary. Useless: Only junk hints. Very Strong: Many powerful hints. Very Strong with Magic: Like the Very Strong hint distribution, but a fixed goal hint with two copies for a Magic Meter is added. All other goals are removed. Battle Royale S2: Battle Royale S2

settings.name: remake_hint_distribution
settings.label: Gossip Stone Hint Mix
settings.tooltip: Use another randomizer's Gossip Stone hint mix instead of OoT Randomizer's.

settings.name: remake_hint_specificity
settings.label: Playthrough Hints Name
settings.tooltip: With the Playthrough mix: hints name an item's area or its exact spot (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: remake_bonus_gossip_hints
settings.label: Bonus Song Hints
settings.tooltip: With the Playthrough mix: the Sun's Song and warp songs get hints too (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: misc_hints
settings.label: Misc. Hints
settings.tooltip: This setting adds some hints at locations other than Gossip Stones: Reading the Temple of Time altar as child will tell you the locations of the Spiritual Stones (unless Maps and Compasses Give Information is enabled). Reading the Temple of Time altar as adult will tell you the locations of the Medallions (unless Maps and Compasses Give Information is enabled), as well as the conditions for building the Rainbow Bridge and getting the Boss Key for Ganon's Castle. Reading the diary of Dampé the gravekeeper as adult will tell you the location of one of the Hookshots. Talking to Ganondorf in his boss room will tell you the location of the Light Arrows. If this option is enabled and Ganondorf is reachable without Light Arrows, Gossip Stones will never hint the Light Arrows. Playing a warp song will tell you where it leads. (If warp song destinations are vanilla, this is always enabled.) The two Owls at Lake Hylia and Death Mountain that move you around will tell you where they go. Talking to a cursed House of Skulltula resident will tell you the reward they will give you for removing their curse. Placing yourself on the log at Zora River where you play the songs for the frogs will tell you what the reward is for playing all six non-warp songs. If shuffled, right side items in the mask shop will be visible but not obtainable before completing the child trade quest. Mask of Truth's shelf slot is always visible. If Shuffle Expensive Merchants is enabled, the three characters that sell a new item will tell what the reward is for buying their item. If Shuffle Magic Beans is enabled, the Magic bean salesman will tell what the reward is for buying the 60 Rupees item. The Poe collector will tell the reward for selling him Big Poes. The sign in Deku Theater will tell the reward for showing the Skull Mask and/or the Mask of Truth.

settings.name: remake_extra_hints
settings.label: Extra Hints
settings.tooltip: Hints beyond OoTR's that this seed shows.

settings.name: remake_scrub_text_hint
settings.label: Scrubs Name Their Item
settings.tooltip: Every Business Scrub with a shuffled item says what it sells (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_loach_hint
settings.label: Pond Owner Names the Loach Prize
settings.tooltip: The fishing pond owner tells what keeping the Hyrule loach gives (Ship of Harkinian). Needs the loach prize shuffled.

settings.name: correct_chest_appearances
settings.label: Chest Appearance Matches Contents
settings.tooltip: If "Texture" is enabled, chest texture will reflect its contents regardless of size. Fancy chests will contain keys, Gilded chests will contain major items, shuffled tokens will be in Webbed chests, and Wooden chests will contain the rest. This allows skipping chests if they are wooden. However, skipping wooden chests will mean having low health, ammo, and rupees, so doing so is a risk. "Size and Texture" will change chests with major items and boss keys into big chests, and everything else into small chests. "Classic" is the behavior of CSMC in previous versions of the randomizer. This will change chests with major items and boss keys into big chests. Boss keys will remain in their fancy chest, while small key will be in a smaller version of the fancy chest.

settings.name: chest_textures_specific
settings.label: Chest Textures
settings.tooltip: Select specific chest textures. Any unchecked option will make all items in the category appear in brown chests.

settings.name: minor_items_as_major_chest
settings.label: Minor Items in Big/Gold chests
settings.tooltip: Chests with Hylian or Deku Shields, Deku Stick or Nut Capacity, or Bombchus will appear in Big and/or Gold chests, depending on the Chest Appearance Matches Contents setting. Bombchus are always in big chests if Add Bombchu Bag and Drops is on.

settings.name: invisible_chests
settings.label: Invisible Chests
settings.tooltip: Chests will only be visible with the Lens of Truth. Lens is not logically required for normally visible chests.

settings.name: correct_potcrate_appearances
settings.label: Pot, Crate, & Beehive Appearance Matches Contents
settings.tooltip: If enabled, pot/crate textures, and beehive wiggling will reflect its contents. Off - Pots, crates, and beehives will appear as vanilla. Texture (Match Content) - Pot and crate textures will reflect the contents. Golden Pots/crates will contain major items. Pots/crates with keys on them will contain small keys. Pots/crates containing boss keys will use a variation of the boss key chest texture. Pots/crates with a spider web on them contain Gold Skulltula tokens. All other items will use the original texture. The texture will revert to the original texture once the item is collected. Beehives containing non-junk items will wiggle until collected. Texture (Unchecked) - All pots/crates containing shuffled items will appear with a golden texture. The texture will revert to the original texture once the item is collected. Beehives will wiggle until their item is collected.

settings.name: key_appearance_match_dungeon
settings.label: Key Appearance Matches Dungeon
settings.tooltip: Small keys and boss keys (not key rings) will use custom models to match their dungeon.

settings.name: potcrate_textures_specific
settings.label: Pot and Crate Textures
settings.tooltip: Select specific pots and crates textures. Any unchecked option will make all items in the category appear in regular pots/crates.

settings.name: remake_item_looks
settings.label: Free-Standing Items Look Like
settings.tooltip: How heart pieces, heart containers and keys standing in the world show the item they hold.

settings.name: ocarina_songs
settings.label: Randomize Ocarina Melodies
settings.tooltip: Will need to memorize a new set of songs. Can be silly, but difficult. All songs are generally sensible, but warp songs are typically more difficult than top row songs. "Top Row Songs": Randomizes Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Time, and Song of Storms. "Warp Songs": Randomizes Minuet of Forest, Bolero of Fire, Serenade of Water, Requiem of Spirit, Nocturne of Shadow, and Prelude of Light. "Frogs Ocarina Game": Randomizes the 14 notes of the final song of the Fabulous Five Froggish Tenors.

settings.name: text_shuffle
settings.label: Text Shuffle
settings.tooltip: Will make things confusing for comedic value. 'Shuffled except Important Text': For when you want comedy but don't want to impact gameplay. Text that has an impact on gameplay is not shuffled. This includes all hint text, key text, Good Deal! items sold in shops, random price scrubs, chicken count and poe count.

settings.name: damage_multiplier
settings.label: Damage Multiplier
settings.tooltip: Changes the amount of damage taken. 'OHKO': Link dies in one hit.

settings.name: remake_damage_multiplier
settings.label: Damage x8 / x16
settings.tooltip: The two damage multipliers beyond OoTR's x4 (Ship of Harkinian / OoT3D Randomizer); logic treats both as one-hit KO.

settings.name: deadly_bonks
settings.label: Bonks Do Damage
settings.tooltip: When rolling, hitting a wall or object will hurt Link. Damage is unaffected by the damage multiplier setting.

settings.name: starting_tod
settings.label: Starting Time of Day
settings.tooltip: Change up Link's sleep routine. Daytime officially starts at 6:30, nighttime at 18:00 (6:00 PM).

settings.name: blue_fire_arrows
settings.label: Blue Fire Arrows
settings.tooltip: Ice arrows gain the power of blue fire. They can be used to melt red ice and break the mud walls in Dodongo's Cavern.

settings.name: remake_slingshot_beehives
settings.label: Slingshot Breaks Beehives
settings.tooltip: The Slingshot breaks beehives as the Bow already does (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_full_wallets
settings.label: Full Wallets
settings.tooltip: Every wallet comes full, and a new file starts with a full wallet (Ship of Harkinian).

settings.name: remake_gk_durability
settings.label: Giant's Knife Durability
settings.tooltip: How many hits the Giant's Knife takes before it breaks (OoT3D Randomizer's GK Durability; one number per seed).

settings.name: remake_gk_durability_hits
settings.label: Giant's Knife Hits
settings.tooltip: With "A set number of hits": how many, 1 to 999.

settings.name: remake_frog_song_timer
settings.label: Frog Song Time per Note
settings.tooltip: 1 (vanilla) to 4 times the time per note in the frogs' final song (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: fix_broken_drops
settings.label: Fix Broken Drops
settings.tooltip: Enabling this fixes drops that are broken in the vanilla game. There is a deku shield drop from a pot in the Spirit Temple child side Anubis room that does not appear in the vanilla game, and logic might require you to get a deku shield this way. There is a magic jar on top of the Gerudo Training Ground eye statue that does not always refill your magic in the vanilla game.

settings.name: tcg_requires_lens
settings.label: Require Lens of Truth for Treasure Chest Game
settings.tooltip: Force the player to always lose the treasure chest game in the first room unless they have the Lens of Truth and a Magic Meter. Does not function if Treasure Chest Game small keys are shuffled.

settings.name: no_collectible_hearts
settings.label: Hero Mode
settings.tooltip: No recovery hearts will drop from enemies or objects. (You might still find some freestanding or in chests depending on other settings.)

settings.name: one_item_per_dungeon
settings.label: Dungeons Have One Major Item
settings.tooltip: Dungeons have exactly one major item. This naturally makes each dungeon similar in value rather than vary based on shuffled locations. Spirit Temple Colossus hands count as part of the dungeon. Spirit Temple has TWO items to match vanilla distribution. Boss Keys and Fortress Keys only count as major items if they are shuffled Anywhere (Keysanity) or in Any Dungeon, and Small Keys only count as major items if they are shuffled Anywhere (Keysanity). This setting is disabled if Small Keys are shuffled in Any Dungeon. GS Tokens only count as major items if the bridge or Ganon Boss Key requirements are set to "GS Tokens". Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart only count as major items if the bridge or Ganon Boss Key requirements are set to "Hearts". Bombchus only count as major items if the "Add Bombchu Bag and Drops" setting is enabled. Pre-completed dungeons (if any) won't have a major item. This setting has potential to conflict with other randomizer settings. Should seeds continuously fail to generate, consider turning this option off.

settings.name: gold_skulls_ignore_daytime
settings.label: Nighttime Skulltulas in Daytime
settings.tooltip: GS Tokens that can only be obtained during the night do not disappear when it is day time.

settings.name: item_pool_value
settings.label: Item Pool
settings.tooltip: 'Ludicrous': Every item in the game is a major item. Incompatible with one major item per dungeon. 'Plentiful': One additional copy of each major item is added. 'Balanced': Original item pool. 'Scarce': An extra copy of major item upgrades that are not required to open location checks is removed (e.g. Bow upgrade, Magic upgrade). Heart Containers are removed as well. Number of Bombchu items is reduced. 'Minimal': All major item upgrades not used to open location checks are removed. All health upgrades are removed. Only one Bombchu item is available.

settings.name: remake_avoid_vanilla_spots
settings.label: No Item in Its Own Spot
settings.tooltip: Off by default, as in OoT Randomizer, whose fill may put an item back in its own spot. Switch it on so that no check keeps its own vanilla item by chance.

settings.name: remake_vanilla_items
settings.label: Items Stay in Their Vanilla Spots
settings.tooltip: Every item goes back to its own spot (OoT3D Randomizer's Vanilla logic). Needs vanilla keys, maps and compasses, vanilla rewards and songs, and "No item in its own spot" off.

settings.name: remake_remove_double_defense
settings.label: No Double Defense
settings.tooltip: Double Defense becomes junk (OoT3D Randomizer).

settings.name: junk_ice_traps
settings.label: Ice Traps
settings.tooltip: 'Off': All Ice Traps are removed. 'Normal': Only Ice Traps from the base item pool are placed. 'Extra Ice Traps': Chance to add extra Ice Traps when junk items are added to the itempool. 'Ice Trap Mayhem': All added junk items will be Ice Traps. 'Ice Trap Onslaught': All junk items will be replaced by Ice Traps, even those in the base pool. 'Custom (count)': Allows specifying a specific number of "Junk items" to be converted to Ice Traps in the pool. 'Custom (%)': Allows specifiying a percentage of "Junk" items to be converted to Ice Traps in the pool.

settings.name: custom_ice_trap_percent
settings.label: Custom Ice Trap Percent
settings.tooltip: Percentage of junk items that will be replaced with Ice Traps when using 'Custom' Ice Traps setting.

settings.name: custom_ice_trap_count
settings.label: Custom Ice Trap Count
settings.tooltip: Number of junk items that will be replaced with Ice Traps when using 'Custom' Ice Traps setting.

settings.name: remake_trap_weight_ice
settings.label: Ice Trap Weight
settings.tooltip: How often a trap is an ice trap, against the other kinds' numbers (0: never).

settings.name: remake_trap_weight_shock
settings.label: Shock Trap Weight
settings.tooltip: How often a trap is a shock trap, against the other kinds' numbers (0: never).

settings.name: remake_trap_weight_fire
settings.label: Fire Trap Weight
settings.tooltip: How often a trap is a fire trap, against the other kinds' numbers (0: never).

settings.name: remake_trap_weight_rupee
settings.label: Rupee Trap Weight
settings.tooltip: How often a trap is a rupee trap, against the other kinds' numbers (0: never).

settings.name: ice_trap_appearance
settings.label: Ice Trap Appearance
settings.tooltip: Changes the categories of items Ice Traps may appear as, both when freestanding and when in chests with Chest Size Matches Contents enabled. 'Major Items Only': Ice Traps appear as Major Items (and in large chests if CSMC enabled). 'Junk Items Only': Ice Traps appear as Junk Items (and in small chests if CSMC enabled). 'Anything': Ice Traps may appear as anything.

settings.name: remake_drop_ice_traps
settings.label: Ice Trap Appearance in Objects
settings.tooltip: What an ice trap hidden in a pot, rock or grass looks like.

settings.name: remake_racing
settings.label: Racing
settings.tooltip: Every racer's seed plays the same: options that change how long scenes take (fanfares, song playbacks) are locked to the game's own.

settings.name: password_lock
settings.label: Lock Seed Behind Password
settings.tooltip: Starting the seed will be locked behind a password provided in the spoiler log. The password is a sequence of 6 button presses (A and C).

settings.name: correct_model_colors
settings.label: Item Model Colors Match Cosmetics
settings.tooltip: In-game models for items such as Heart Containers have colors matching the colors chosen for cosmetic settings. Heart and magic drop icons also have matching colors. Tunic colors are excluded from this to prevent not being able to discern freestanding Tunics from each other.

settings.name: randomize_all_cosmetics
settings.label: Randomize All Cosmetics
settings.tooltip: Randomize all cosmetics settings, except those in the "General Cosmetics" and the "Player Models" sections.

settings.name: remake_ocarina_controls
settings.label: Ocarina Controls
settings.tooltip: As in the game's Options. Ocarina note items show the button that plays their note.

settings.name: remake_controller
settings.label: Controller
settings.tooltip: The button labels Ocarina note items show.
choices: Nintendo (A B X Y, L R)
Xbox (A B X Y, LB RB)
PlayStation (cross circle square triangle, L1 R1)
Steam Deck (A B X Y, L1 R1)

settings.label: Mirror Shield Frame Color
