settings.name: navi_color_default_inner
settings.label: Navi Idle Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.name: navi_color_enemy_inner
settings.label: Navi Targeting Enemy Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.label: Navi Targeting Prop Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.label: Bombchu Trail Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.name: boomerang_trail_color_inner
settings.label: Boomerang Trail Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.label: Outer
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.name: sword_trail_color_inner
settings.label: Sword Trail Inner
settings.tooltip: 'Random Choice': Choose a random color from this list of colors. 'Completely Random': Choose a random color from any color the N64 can draw. 'Rainbow': Cycle through a color rainbow.

settings.name: randomize_all_sfx
settings.label: Randomize All Sound Effects
settings.tooltip: Randomize all sound effects and music settings (ear safe), except the "Adult Voice" and "Child Voice" options and those in the "General" section.

settings.name: remake_shuffle_all_sfx
settings.label: Shuffle Every Sound Effect
settings.tooltip: Every sound effect swaps with another of the same kind that the same actor already has: a loop with a loop, a voice with a voice, a short sound with a short one (OoT3D Randomizer's Shuffle SFX, categorical), footsteps and Link's voice included. The sound settings below still choose their own sounds; music, fanfares and the ocarina keep their settings.

settings.name: disable_battle_music
settings.label: Disable Battle Music
settings.tooltip: Disable standard battle music. This prevents background music from being interrupted by the battle theme when being near enemies.

settings.name: background_music
settings.label: Background Music
settings.tooltip: 'No Music': No background music is played. 'Random': Area background music is randomized. Additional music can be loaded from data/Music/

settings.name: fanfares
settings.label: Fanfares
settings.tooltip: 'No Fanfares': No fanfares (short non-looping tracks) are played. 'Random': Fanfares are randomized. Additional fanfares can be loaded from data/Music/

settings.name: ocarina_fanfares
settings.label: Ocarina Songs as Fanfares
settings.tooltip: Include the songs that play when an ocarina song is played as part of the fanfare pool when shuffling or disabling fanfares. Note that these are a bit longer than most fanfares.

settings.name: credits_music
settings.label: Credits music as BGM
settings.tooltip: Include the songs that play when the credits roll as part of the music pool when shuffling music.

settings.name: sfx_ocarina
settings.label: Ocarina
settings.tooltip: Change the instrument used when playing the ocarina.

settings.name: sfx_bombchu_move
settings.label: Bombchu
settings.tooltip: Change the sound bombchus make when moving.

settings.name: sfx_hover_boots
settings.label: Hover Boots
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of the hover boots when in air.

settings.name: sfx_iron_boots
settings.label: Iron Boots
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of Iron boots.

settings.name: sfx_boomerang_throw
settings.label: Boomerang Throw
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of the Boomerang flying in the air.

settings.name: sfx_hookshot_chain
settings.label: Hookshot Chain
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of the Hookshot extending.

settings.name: sfx_arrow_shot
settings.label: Arrow Shot
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of a regular arrow shot.

settings.name: sfx_slingshot_shot
settings.label: Slingshot Shot
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of a Slingshot shot.

settings.name: sfx_magic_arrow_shot
settings.label: Magic Arrow Shot
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of a Magic arrow shot.

settings.name: sfx_explosion

settings.tooltip: Change the sound of a bomb exploding.

settings.tooltip: Change Link's adult voice.

settings.name: sfx_link_child

settings.tooltip: Change Link's child voice.

settings.name: sfx_navi_enemy
settings.label: Navi Enemy
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of Navi targetting an enemy.

settings.name: sfx_horse_neigh

settings.tooltip: Change the sound of Epona and other horses.

settings.name: sfx_cucco
settings.label: Cucco
settings.tooltip: Change the sound of Cuccos.

settings.name: sfx_daybreak
settings.label: Daybreak
settings.tooltip: Change the sound when morning comes.
